specific_answers.two_models_at_once: No. One generative model per process (lib.rs:240-243). The request `model` field is ignored. The only second model is the optional FERRIC_RERANK_MODEL cross-encoder for /v1/rerank.
specific_answers.chat_template: Hard-coded, not the model's Jinja. The GGUF template is read into Engine.template and never used (rustc dead-code warning this session). There are four families (ChatML, Llama-3, Gemma, Phi-3), detected from vocabulary tokens, with a 'role: content' fallback.
specific_answers.tool_call_parsing: Yes, in one format only: Hermes/Qwen <tool_call>{json}</tool_call> with a bare-JSON fallback (ferric-agent/src/tools.rs:45-62). A server-side MCP loop runs up to 4 rounds. No streaming with tools.
specific_answers.joules_per_request: No. The response carries token usage only. SpecGate uses a structural 1/n_layer energy ratio, not a measurement. ferric-joule's meters (Macmon, RAPL, nvidia-smi, battery) and the macmon harness scripts are not wired into the server.
